svg.title: Connections for in-line, right-angle and forty-five-degree shafts
svg.desc: In-line shafts use a coupling; spur gears belong on parallel axes. A pair of kit bevel gears connects shafts at its designed ninety-degree angle. A universal joint connects the forty-five-degree shafts. This does not mean bevel gears cannot be manufactured for other fixed angles. The equal bevel gears drawn have 16 teeth each and share a pitch-cone apex, with a half-tooth phase offset.

g.text: Choose a connection that fits the shaft angle
Shaft centerlines are schematic. A joint can bend; a bevel pair has a fixed angle.
